description: arXMCP cache hit-ratio and request-latency operational dashboard. Built for E14_S09 (Tier-5 operational visibility). Provisioned via infra/observability/grafana-provisioning.yml.

panels.description: Cache hit ratio per tier (1=SQLite, 2=ANN, 3=LRU). Higher is better. Computed as hits/lookups over the trailing 5 minutes. Source metrics: arxmcp_cache_hits_total{tier}, arxmcp_cache_lookups_total{tier} (server/metrics.py).
panels.title: Cache hit ratio per tier

panels.description: Embedder singleflight dedup rate (events/sec over 5-min window). Each event is a query that piggy-backed on an in-flight encode call rather than triggering a redundant forward pass. Higher rate means more concurrent agents are sharing encode passes. Source: arxmcp_embed_singleflight_dedup_total (server/health.py). Rate visualization chosen over cumulative counter so operators see a flat line at zero (no concurrency) vs an active line (dedup happening), not a monotonic staircase.
panels.title: Embedder singleflight dedup rate (5m)

panels.description: Reranker latency percentiles (P50, P95) per model. Source: arxmcp_rerank_latency_seconds_bucket{model} (server/observability/metrics.py). Watch P95; cold-start spikes are expected on first request after model load.
panels.title: Reranker latency P50/P95 by model

panels.description: Per-tool request-handler latency P95 (wall-clock, includes downstream retrieval). Source: arxmcp_request_latency_seconds_bucket{tool} (server/observability/metrics.py). The 5s bucket ceiling matches ARXMCP_DEFAULT_TOOL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS — anything above 5s is a timeout, tracked separately.
panels.title: Per-tool request latency P95

panels.description: Active concurrent in-flight tool handler invocations per tool. Source: arxmcp_request_inflight{tool} (server/observability/metrics.py). Sustained nonzero on a single tool indicates either a long-running call or runaway concurrency.
panels.title: Active inflight requests per tool

title: arXMCP — Cache and Latency
